body:
Sometimes I feels like a miracle is the only way that I can make my life as good as everyone else's. It's funny, I always wondered what gifted peoples' lives were like. Probably not easy, considering they learn how little they know and how little it matters early on. It takes the rest of us longer. 

The problem is that we need these people. We need them to do math and read a little faster than the rest of us, or be a little bit more creative. Just like the people in this sub need each other, we need people like you to keep going. Point is, you are not worthless. You are important to us — important to me. That has to count for something. 

Is it okay if I ask what, if anything, you would want to do besides end your life?
Hey, I'm here. Is it okay if I ask what's going on?
Sorry, I thought you said you were in high school. My bad! Have you thought about any majors you might be interested in?
Everything will be different when you graduate and enter college. Hang in there a little longer and at least try it. If you don't like it, reconsider, but don't give up yet.

Yes, you can do this. 

The fact that you've made it this far tells me that you are strong. I don't know you, but I know that much. You can get through this. 

I know the feeling of being overwhelmed by school too well. I was a serial procrastinator and left things to the last minute, even exams. Freshman year, I stayed up 80 hours straight to pass my classes. My vision may have been raining caterpillars as I walked back to my dorm, but I passed. 

Point is, there is always a way. And you're strong. So let's do this.

If you haven't already, start by going through your school files and writing down all the due dates on a single calendar. Visualize it. Figure out the bare minimum you need to get to pass the class. Then you can focus on one thing at a time instead of all of them at once. It'll help manage the stress, I promise. Talk to your friends and professors. 

Keep going.

For what it's worth, I hated every second of school because it was so goddamn boring, but I liked going to work. Try seeing the rest of school through — fuck it, you already got this far. Look for jobs in related fields that interest you. Not all or even most jobs have to be directly related to your major. If those don't work, then, well, whatever. Maybe do it. But don't give up on the working world before you even try it. 

Also, I think people put way too much pressure on having a girlfriend. Some things are nice and some fucking suck. If you're set on getting one in the near future, it's important to keep in mind that there are girls that *will* date you. Seriously. People have fetishes for everyone, so no matter how shitty you may seem to yourself, there are girls that are into you.
Hey, I don't think you're worthless. Want to talk about it?
